scope: Explicit enrollment and read-only profile loading; no installed-host or phase acceptance
platform: Native Linux in WSL; Go1.27.2 linux/amd64
command: GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go test -race -json ./launcher
assertions: Two concurrent enrollments publish exactly one complete profile without overwrite
Load refuses escaped/nested duplicate keys, unknown/missing/null fields, oversized/trailing JSON and separately trusted fingerprint mismatch
Private real file and directory modes, UID mismatch, symlink and hard-link refusals
Remote TLS declaration never selects or invokes local Docker, even with conflicting ambient Docker environment
No endpoint, credential reference, executable or private directory in default public summary
Local Docker and NATS endpoint declarations are explicit; local NATS is loopback-only
limits: Actual native macOS execution remains required; portable source is not native qualification
Installed release policy must come from trusted launcher installation; comparing fingerprints does not prove signature validation or key enrollment
Profiles declare credential references; this slice does not read credentials, authenticate NATS, validate runtime config integrity or authorize organization/project access
Caller supplies existing canonical private directory and workspace roots; full installer/enrollment discovery and terminal hook integration remain later work
Same-UID or privileged filesystem mutation is not sandboxed; failures after exclusive publication may leave a complete profile, never overwrite an existing profile
No broker, Docker engine, provider, legacy state, or Jev access in profile operations
